why: The shapes repeat in order: star, arrowhead, flower, flower, star, so the next shape is an arrowhead. The black part grows when a shape comes back: the star went from a thin black edge to half black, so the arrowhead goes from half black to fully black. Option 1 is the all-black arrowhead. Option 2 is still only half black.
trick: Split the series into shape and shading, and compare each shape with its own earlier copy.
note: The rule is not very clear in the book; the book answer is option 1.
